pages.text: With $(l)Siege Weapons$(), $(l)Medieval Siege Machines$() or $(l)Kingdom Sieges$(), the Blacksmith gains a $(l)War machines$() tab: catapults, ballistae, trebuchets, mortars, culverins, rams, ladders and more. Most need Engineering; cannons need Steelmaking.

When you raid, the attacking city takes $(l)one engine$() from its stockpile. It sets up outside the target, crewed and stocked with ammunition, and bombards the town centre: a Recruits $(l)Siege Engineer$() works Siege Weapons; a bowman works Siege Machines (needs Recruits Siege Compatibility).

When the raid ends the crew leaves; an engine that survived goes back to the stockpile.$(br2)NPC kingdoms of $(l)City$() rank bring an engine too.$(br2)Recruit Command's $(l)Promotions$() page offers Siege Engineer (Siege Weapons) and Captain (Small Ships) once those mods are installed.
